🚄 One day of Renfe trains in Spain — Thursday 15 October 2026.

5,947 Renfe trains: AVE, Avlo and Avant radiate from Madrid while Cercanías and Rodalies pulse around Madrid and Barcelona. 532 high-speed runs in a day. Busiest moments: 599 trains on the move at 08:32, 605 at 19:56. Iryo and Ouigo are not included (no open timetable).

📊 Data: Renfe Data GTFS (data.renfe.com), CC BY 4.0. Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
